title: Hakodate Bay, December 2023 | DeerFlow visual research

items.title: Kanemori warehouse façades · Hakotamu
items.excerpt: Two adjoining red-brick gables have corbelled brickwork, dark metal wall ties, and pale trim around arched entrances. Warm lights trace the gables and arched openings, and red-and-white climbing Santa figures appear on the brick façades during the holiday display.

items.title: Warehouse street in winter · Hakotamu
items.excerpt: A pedestrian street runs beside repeated red-brick warehouse gables toward a mountain with towers on its summit. Patches of snow appear on rooftops and on the hillside, with a mostly exposed pavement and short bollards along the frontage.

items.title: Waterfront promenade · Hakotamu
items.excerpt: Warm-white outlines trace the warehouse gables along the quay. A low railing borders the pedestrian promenade beside dark water. Broken gold, red, white and blue reflections run across the harbor below the lit tree. The tree's color varies by display phase, so match the opening photograph.

items.title: 2023 Hakodate Christmas Fantasy poster
items.excerpt: The poster locates the floating Christmas tree on the water in front of the Red Brick Warehouses during December 1–25. It lists scheduled red-light phases and a daily fireworks display at 18:00. Those events were time-specific and the schedule does not establish that either is underway in the reference image.

items.title: Snow and street illumination · Hakotamu
items.excerpt: An adjoining street shows warm-white lights wrapped around bare branches, irregular snow at curbs and around shrubs, and colored reflections on wet asphalt. The photo shows patches of settled snow. Falling snow is unconfirmed.

items.title: Illuminated gables and stone walkway · Hakoshin
items.excerpt: Round-arched glazed doorways repeat under steep warehouse gables outlined in warm-white lights. A broad walkway is paved in pale slabs. Winter-clad pedestrians and climbing Santa decorations appear in this holiday view.

items.title: Christmas tree at the event opening · Mainichi
items.excerpt: The lit tree has an irregular conical silhouette, densely lit branches and a pale rectangular base. The opening-event photograph shows one multicolored lighting phase and a crowd facing the tree. Crowd size and light colors vary with the viewpoint and moment.
